summary: Frontend-only theme sweep verification for HUBXBOT/TGX. All 15 pages (Home, Market, Wallet, Bot Hub, TradingPair, Transactions, Referral, Rank, Revenue, Rewards, News, Guide, BindAPI, Profile, Login) render correctly in the new palette (Pure White base + Emerald #16A34A / Deep Teal #0F766E / Midnight Teal #083344 gradient hero cards). Theme toggle on Profile flips light<->dark via data-testid='theme-toggle', persists to localStorage key 'hubxbot-theme-v2', body background switches white(#FFFFFF) <-> midnight(#05222B). All hero cards use --hero-grad (linear-gradient 135deg emerald->teal->midnight) confirmed via computed styles. All modals open on Bot Hub (deposit/withdraw/p2p) and Wallet (wallet-deposit/wallet-withdraw/wallet-transfer). All interactive flows work: market search+tabs+row navigation, tx filter pills+expand, referral copy, rank prev/next, pair act-buy/act-sell.

verification_details.invisible_text_scan: Automated CSS colour-distance scan reported false positives on all hero cards because their solid background-color is transparent (real bg is background-image gradient); manual screenshot inspection confirmed WHITE text on emerald->teal->midnight gradient is fully readable on every hero. NO true invisible text found on any page in either light or dark theme.
verification_details.expected_noise: wss://stream.binance.com 451 errors in console are the documented geo-block in demo mode (per review request) - NOT a bug

critical_code_review_comments: ThemeContext (lines 10, 21) uses localStorage key 'hubxbot-theme-v2' consistent with review request - good.

index.css has duplicate @layer base :root block (lines 128-151) with legacy HSL vars (--background 224 60% 5%, --primary 183 100% 50%) that conflict with the new palette :root vars (lines 11-61). Legacy vars are still consumed by shadcn/ui primitives (Dialog, Button, Card default variants). Not causing visible issues today because most pages use inline style={{color:'var(--text)'}} + explicit tailwind classes, but this dead/conflicting block should be removed or migrated so shadcn primitives inherit the new emerald palette.

Profile.jsx wraps the actual ThemeToggle in a card with data-testid='theme-setting'; the toggle-triggering element is [data-testid='theme-toggle'] inside. Consider moving the click handler to the outer card or document this in testing notes; testing agents may click the wrong element.

Wallet.jsx uses data-testid='wallet-deposit / wallet-withdraw / wallet-transfer' while Bot Hub uses 'btn-open-deposit / btn-open-withdraw / btn-open-p2p'. Naming is inconsistent across pages - consider unifying (e.g. all as btn-open-<action> or all as <page>-<action>).
server.py backend file was NOT touched per request (frontend-only testing) - carrying forward existing note from iteration_18: server.py ~1951 lines still needs modularisation.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (15/15 pages + theme toggle + 6 modals + all interactive flows)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Theme sweep is fully verified in both light (default) and dark themes on mobile 390x844. If future changes affect hero cards, note that solid background-color of hero elements is transparent - the visible bg comes from background-image: var(--hero-grad) on the card wrapper. Any automated CSS contrast/invisibility scan MUST also read backgroundImage and compare against the gradient stops, otherwise it will produce false positives (as this iteration saw). Correct testids for critical flows: theme toggle -> [data-testid='theme-toggle'] on /profile; Wallet actions -> wallet-deposit / wallet-withdraw / wallet-transfer; Bot Hub actions -> btn-open-deposit / btn-open-withdraw / btn-open-p2p; Bot Hub modals do not use role='dialog' (custom bottom sheet) - assert visibility by looking for the amount input or the confirm-* CTA instead.
rca of the issue: N/A - no functional issues found. The colour sweep preserved all interactive flows and produced readable text in both themes on every page.
